products: quarter, half and whole beef (roasts, steaks, stew meat, ground beef)

feeding_claim.verbatim: Everything our cattle eat is a local plant product.

availability.note: Waitlist for fall 2026 or 2027 beef; join by emailing beef@saguarojuniper.org.

notes: Non-profit conservation and community cattle ranch near Cascabel. On 2026-11-15 the saguarojuniper.org pastoralism page was blocked, so feeding and sales were confirmed on the ranch's other site, saguaro-juniper.com/food/beef.html (Natural Grass-fed Beef, updated June 2025): cattle eat only local plants, beef is picked up cut, wrapped and frozen in Tucson or Willcox, sold directly, and buyers contact beef@saguarojuniper.org for availability. No grain or finishing wording, so category grass-fed. Waitlist status is from the Scout check on 2026-11-11 and was not rechecked. farm-pickup stands for the Tucson and Willcox pickups.
